title: Mechanical Assembly Engineer
company: Yield Engineering Systems India P Ltd
jobDescription: YES (Yield Engineering Systems, Inc.) is a leading manufacturer of reliable, high-tech, cost-effective capital equipment that transforms materials and surfaces at the nanoscale. From startups to the Fortune 50, our customers rely on YES to help them unleash products that change lives – from cell phones and Io T devices, to AI and virtual reality, to diagnostic tests for COVID. As a preferred provider of wet and dry process technology, we look forward to talking with smart, energetic, team-oriented people who can grow with us. We provide competitive salary and benefits, including long term incentives and some of the best co-workers you’ll find anywhere. If this appeals to you, please read on! Job Title: Mechanical Assembly Engineer Location: Coimbatore Responsibilities include but are not limited to: Able to read drawings for Systems involving Mechanical & Electrical parts. Worked in Assembling of fabricated & Standard components into a larger machine or system. Ability to determine the sequence of operations & Interpret from Process / Control plans, Work instructions. Knowledge on Precision manufacturing processes in Machining, Fabrication, Welding & Post treatment processes. Experience in Fabrication assembly, Hydraulics and Pneumatics installation. Ability to select & use appropriate hand and power tools for Assembly process. Ability to measure, determine root cause and perform minor structural reworks to suit assembly. Knowledge in Plastic welding, Sheetmetal Fabrication process will be added advantage. Communication: Ability to coordinate with Design & Engineering departments to receive information’s & provide Feedback from Assembly. Responsible for 5S, Health & Safety protocols & Floor Equipment’s – Stock, Calibration & Maintenance processes. Education Qualification: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering 3 to 5 years’ experience in Assembly of Machinery or Equipment’s. Compensation: YES offers a stimulating and fun working environment, competitive salaries and benefits, and long-term incentives. Additional Information: YES is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. Come find out why YES is such a great place to work. Apply today!
